description: Compatibility shim only: Node 24's `--test` positional argument does not expand a directory, so `node --test integrations/dsh-fishmemory/test/` resolves this directory through `main` and runs the test file. Prefer `node --test "integrations/dsh-fishmemory/test/*.test.mjs"` or root `node --test`; add new test files as `*.test.mjs` and run them with the glob form.
